base.//: Pins the toolchain so the builder resolves dependencies the same way the lockfile was written. Builds failed repeatedly on `npm ci` with 'lock file's ajv@6.14.0 does not satisfy ajv@8.20.0 / Missing: ajv@6.15.0': eslint declares ajv ^6.14.0, ajv 6.15.0 was published, and the builder's older npm resolved the range to the newer release while the lockfile pinned the older one. Without a pin this recurs every time any transitive dependency publishes a patch.
